proposals.candidate_label: degree-aware multi-view graph contrast for LightGCN
proposals.expected_signal: If sparse-user/item noise is limiting full-sort ranking, adding a lightweight contrastive auxiliary across two stochastic graph views with degree-aware edge dropout should improve embedding uniformity
proposals.failure_mode: Contrastive regularization can over-separate semantically related neighbors or wash out collaborative signal, causing pairwise ranking quality to stay flat or drop despite smoother embeddings.
proposals.hypothesis: The current lineage may be under-regularized at the representation level. A LightGCN variant that keeps the main recommendation loss intact but adds a degree-aware two-view contrastive auxiliary can test whether better invariance to missing edges improves NDCG@10 without changing protocol or relying on parameter-only-t
